rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the signing target sweeps a distribution/output folder
Recognized that multiple projects write to the same output folder
Connected the access-denied error to file ownership or read-only constraints (such as CAS hard links in CloudBuild)
Explained why the failure is non-deterministic (depends on project build order / timing)
Suggested separating project outputs or removing redundant Distrib/Robocopy configurations from library projects

scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose why code signing fails with access denied
scenarios.reasoning: The agent did a competent job investigating the binlog and identifying the general pattern - a file in a shared output directory causing signing failures. It correctly identified the cross-project nature of the problem and the race condition timing. However, it missed the specific CloudBuild CAS hard-link mechanism that makes files read-only (not just temporarily locked), which is the deeper root cause. The fixes suggested are reasonable but somewhat generic rather than targeting the specific configuration issue (redundant Distrib/Robocopy in library projects).
